story.title: My security camera shipped a GitHub admin token in its login page

draft:
I just read about a security camera that shipped with a GitHub admin token in its login page. 
This is a stark reminder of the risks of hardcoded credentials. 
I'm concerned about the potential for similar oversights in other IoT devices. 
What steps can we take to prevent this kind of vulnerability?
#IoTSecurity #GitHub #SecurityCameras
